_comment: Provider-agnostic model routing for the editorial automation. Roles map to an ORDERED list of candidate models (best-first). The Computer-side runner picks the first candidate it can run; the budget governor may force a downgrade to the cheapest acceptable candidate. Prices are coarse per-run estimates in USD used ONLY for ledger bookkeeping and budget math — they are intentionally conservative (overestimate) so the governor errs on the side of caution. Update prices/candidates here without touching any script; routing is data-driven, never hard-coded.

price_basis._comment: est_cost_per_run_usd is a blended, conservative per-invocation estimate for a single Pulse research/editorial/validation task (typical token volume for one signal + weekly-connection context). Used for ledger entries and budget projection only. Not a billing source of truth.

research._comment: Reads new data + existing content, researches what changed and why it matters, produces structured findings. Needs strong reasoning + current-web grounding. Best-first.

candidates.notes: Newest frontier reasoning; best for the hardest 'what does this mean' analysis.
Top-tier reasoning fallback if gpt_5_5 unavailable.
Cheapest acceptable research model; downgrade target under budget pressure.

editorial._comment: Phase 2+. Rewrites findings into plain, grade<=9 language. Not invoked in Phase 1. Defined now so routing is stable when Phase 2 lands.

candidates.notes: Best prose quality + instruction-following for plain-language rewrite.

validation._comment: Phase 2+. Independent quality-gate check (source support, number accuracy, direction alignment, reading level, disclaimer, unsupported claims). Should be a DIFFERENT provider than editorial where possible, to avoid same-model blind spots. Not invoked in Phase 1.

candidates.notes: Cheap, large context, different provider than editorial — good independent checker.
